description: This source file provides APIs for retrieving device processor information, including processor count and architecture, and manages instances of device processor interfaces with thread safety.

classes.name: hostIf_DeviceProcessorInterface
classes.description: Class managing device processor information, including instance creation, destruction, and retrieval of processor count and architecture.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns an instance of hostIf_DeviceProcessorInterface for a given device ID, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getAllInstances
methods.description: Returns a list of all existing hostIf_DeviceProcessorInterface instances.

methods.name: closeInstance
methods.description: Removes and deletes a specific device processor interface instance.

methods.name: closeAllInstances
methods.description: Removes and deletes all device processor interface instances.

methods.name: getNumOfProcessorEntries
methods.description: Counts the number of processors by reading /proc/cpuinfo.

methods.name: get_Device_DeviceInfo_Processor_Architecture
methods.description: Retrieves the architecture of the device's processor using uname.
